The refuter was correct that the old definition used U subset R^{n-1} and an n x n determinant for n vectors in R^{n+1}, which is ill-formed. The current definition repairs this to a space-time hypersurface parameterized by U subset R^n and an (n+1) x (n+1) determinant with n tangent directions plus the transport vector.

The refuter was correct that the old proof step 2.1 tried to invert a nonsquare derivative because the supporting Cauchy-surface definition had the wrong dimension. After repairing the definition to use n tangent directions in space-time, D Phi(0,eta_*) is square and invertible, so the fatal defect is confirmed and fixed.

The refuter was correct that the old witness family u(x,t)=F(x-t) omitted the C^1 regularity needed for classical solutions. The current proof now uses the explicit C^1 witnesses F_0(s)=0 and F_1(s)=s, so the fatal missing-hypothesis defect is confirmed and repaired.

The refuter was correct that the example claimed a classical solution without a regularity hypothesis on u_0. The current statement now requires u_0 in C^1(R^n), which is exactly the missing hypothesis needed for the translate formula to define a classical solution, so the fatal finding is confirmed and the statement is narrowed.

The refuter was correct that the example claimed a classical solution without assuming u_0 is C^1. The current statement now adds that hypothesis, so the displayed integrating-factor formula is again a classical solution and the fatal finding is confirmed by narrowing the statement.

The refuter was correct that the old Gronwall argument in step 3.1 only justified the forward-time branch. The current proof now splits t>=t_0 and t<=t_0 before applying Gronwall, producing the uniform bound e^{M|t-t_0|} and a valid C(I)-Cauchy argument, so the nonfatal defect is confirmed and fixed.

The refuter was correct that the old statement identified whole fibres M x {q} as leaves even when M is disconnected. The current example repairs this by taking the connected components of the fibres, which is the correct product foliation, so the fatal missing-hypothesis finding is confirmed and fixed.

The refuter was correct that the old statement called the noncentral leaves copies of R. In the stated quotient, one horizontal pass changes the transverse sign and a second pass returns to the starting class, so each leaf with t != 0 is a circle; the fatal false claim is confirmed and repaired.

The refuter was correct that the old matrix ODE had the wrong transpose, so the bracket computation in steps 1.2-1.3 did not cancel. The current proof now solves d_t B=-C^T B, which makes each coefficient vanish exactly, so the fatal unlicensed-inference finding is confirmed and fixed.

The mandatory high-risk reread found that the old final step identified the leaves from the coset partition without proving that the cosets were maximal connected integral manifolds. The current proof now writes the explicit integral curve c_g(t)=g(I+tE_{12}) and uses maximal-integral-manifold uniqueness to identify the leaf through g with gH, so this supplemental nonfatal defect is confirmed and fixed.
